answer: Each vertex in the task graph pays 2 sable to answer, and its reply is checked against a hidden anchor solution. The 30-sable pool is split per distinct passing answer, and copies of one answer share a single slice. With three passing answers, a slice is 10 sable. A farm pushing one answer through ten identities pays 20 in fees to split 10, losing 10. Beyond five copies it is in the red. Distinct correct answers still earn, but each costs real work.
